name: HTML - Links & Navigation
description: Learn to create links that connect the web

rules.text: Add a link using the <a> tag with an href attribute
rules.hint: Links connect web pages! Use: <a href="https://google.com">Click me</a>. The href attribute tells the browser where to go when clicked.
Add more links to different websites. Try linking to your favorite sites or useful resources!

completion.message: 🎉 Amazing! You can now connect pages with links!
